description: Where each epoch's callout label goes in the main-text ticket strip, relative to its circled burst: left, right, above-left, above-right, below, below-left, below-right, or down (the lowest clear row, with a vertical leader). The generator tries that side first (nearest positions first) and falls back to any clear position. "spans" replaces an epoch's burst with an explicit ticket range, for a multi-day wave that overnight gaps split into runs smaller than its largest burst.

cpu-combo.why: The Luna-tier CPU combo wave (T179-T207, 5-8 Oct) spans overnight gaps; its largest 4-hour burst (T211-T221) is the later Sol-tier public-route work.
